name: sales-integration-learning
description: Local sales management integration test learning with Playwright

scripts.test:unit: npm run sales:test:unit && npm run sales:test:verification
scripts.sales:check: tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck demo/sales/*.ts test-support/*.ts test-support/auth/*.ts tests/targets/sales/*.ts tests/scenarios/*/*.ts tests/verification/*/*.ts
scripts.sales:test: npm run sales:check && npm run sales:test:unit && npm run sales:test:verification && playwright test -c playwright.sales.config.ts
